Scorecard keeps public-default-branch publication in a separate workflow. Reusable security checks request no OIDC permission; YAML policy checks and linters pass.
Parsed YAML gate dependencies cover every CI/security job and match the invoked evaluator. Security evaluator tests reject missing, failed, cancelled and unexpected skipped prerequisites.

A retry skips npm only if registry identity and SHA-512 integrity equal the verified candidate. A missing registry version enables publication; mismatches, registry errors and network errors fail closed. Publishing itself was not performed.

Contributor attribution policy was left intact. No change to scripts/check-release.mjs.
